accuracy.reason: Roles, HTTP semantics, state dependency and uncertain outcomes are accurate; live RFC, Azure and MDN checks support them. No false guarantee.

evidence.quote: These are roles in an interaction, not types of computer.

mechanisms.reason: Request interpretation, access checks, state location, server loss and lost-response uncertainty provide causal traces for every card objective. Diagrams correctly direct requests and replies; stateless routing is qualified by adjacent text.

evidence.quote: If the only copy is in Server A's memory, later requests depend on A.

coherence.reason: Roles lead to shared rules, then state, dependencies and a synthesized request explanation. All five card objectives build on introduced concepts; no recurring scenario is needed.

evidence.quote: Their locations determine which dependencies the operation needs and what survives replacing a handler.

decisions.reason: Client-local responsiveness/offline work is paired with synchronization costs; centralized service benefits are paired with network and capacity costs. Retry uncertainty is bounded.

evidence.quote: Shared changes then need synchronization across devices.

clarity.reason: Session state, protocol and API are defined; local-memory contrast is a useful selective example. Shared renderer maps zero-based diagrams to the correct cards and CSS preserves reading order.

evidence.quote: Session state is context retained across related requests, such as sign-in status.

outcomes.reason: All five criteria: actual learner identifies interaction roles and dual role, complete message fields, shared protocol interpretation and application success/error semantics. Exact lesson evidence entails each.

All six criteria: learner explains local-session dependency, request/shared context, replacement and storage dependency, central rules, latency/unavailability/overload and absence of automatic scale or availability.

All three criteria: learner combines taught fields and checks into permitted work and response, explicitly locates persistent/session data, and correctly contrasts explicit failure with unknown no-response outcome. Its illustrative storage placement is supported and not represented as mandatory.

sourceChecks.claim: RFC 9110 section 3.3 verifies client/server interaction roles and one program serving both roles.
RFC 9110 sections 1.3 and 3.4 verify shared semantics and message fields; OWASP REST Security followup verifies server endpoint access enforcement.
Azure autoscaling application-design section verifies stateless instance independence and surviving storage dependencies.
MDN server-side introduction verifies shared server data/business work versus client presentation; Azure scaling guidance confirms bottlenecks and finite capacity.
RFC 9110 section 9.2.2 verifies a missing response may follow an applied request and retries need semantic justification.
